mapper.select: SELECT revision, execution_mode, model, effort, max_concurrent_analyses, default_max_concurrent_per_credential, max_queued_analyses, max_input_bytes, max_output_bytes, max_runtime_ms, row_version FROM analysis_runtime_configuration WHERE singleton_id = TRUE
mapper.update: UPDATE analysis_runtime_configuration SET revision = revision + 1, execution_mode = #{row.executionMode}, model = #{row.model}, effort = #{row.effort}, max_concurrent_analyses = #{row.maxConcurrentAnalyses}, default_max_concurrent_per_credential = #{row.defaultMaxConcurrentPerCredential}, max_queued_analyses = #{row.maxQueuedAnalyses}, max_input_bytes = #{row.maxInputBytes}, max_output_bytes = #{row.maxOutputBytes}, max_runtime_ms = #{row.maxRuntimeMs}, row_version = row_version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE singleton_id = TRUE AND row_version = #{expectedRowVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM analysis_provider_credentials WHERE retired_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at, credential_ref
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analysis_provider_credentials ( credential_ref, device_id, provider, connection_fingerprint, credential_generation, label, self_reported_tier, desired_enabled, desired_max_concurrent, drain_requested_at, retired_at, observed_connection_state, observed_cli_version, observed_model_capabilities, observed_quota_state, observed_quota_at, next_eligible_at, runtime_epoch, observation_sequence, last_assigned_ordinal, row_version ) VALUES ( COALESCE(#{credentialRef}, uuidv7()), #{deviceId}, 'ANTIGRAVITY', #{connectionFingerprint}, #{credentialGeneration}, #{label}, #{selfReportedTier}, #{desiredEnabled}, #{desiredMaxConcurrent}, #{drainRequestedAt}, #{retiredAt}, #{observedConnectionState}, #{cliVersion}, CAST(#{modelCapabilitiesJson} AS jsonb), #{observedQuotaState}, #{quotaObservedAt}, #{nextEligibleAt}, #{runtimeEpoch}, #{observationSequence}, #{lastAssignedOrdinal}, 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE analysis_provider_credentials SET connection_fingerprint = #{row.connectionFingerprint}, credential_generation = #{row.credentialGeneration}, label = #{row.label}, self_reported_tier = #{row.selfReportedTier}, desired_enabled = #{row.desiredEnabled}, desired_max_concurrent = #{row.desiredMaxConcurrent}, drain_requested_at = #{row.drainRequestedAt}, retired_at = #{row.retiredAt}, observed_connection_state = #{row.observedConnectionState}, observed_cli_version = #{row.cliVersion}, observed_model_capabilities = CAST(#{row.modelCapabilitiesJson} AS jsonb), observed_quota_state = #{row.observedQuotaState}, observed_quota_at = #{row.quotaObservedAt}, next_eligible_at = #{row.nextEligibleAt}, runtime_epoch = #{row.runtimeEpoch}, observation_sequence = #{row.observationSequence}, last_assigned_ordinal = #{row.lastAssignedOrdinal}, row_version = row_version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE credential_ref = #{row.credentialRef} AND row_version = #{expectedRowVersion}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chapter_analysis_execution_snapshots ( generation_job_id, execution_mode, profile_json, prompt_version, prompt_hash, prompt_template, schema_version, schema_hash, response_schema_json, input_fingerprint, config_revision, created_at ) VALUES ( #{generationJobId}, #{executionMode}, CAST(#{profileJson} AS jsonb), #{promptVersion}, #{promptHash}, #{promptTemplate}, #{schemaVersion}, #{schemaHash}, CAST(#{responseSchemaJson} AS jsonb), #{inputFingerprint}, #{configRevision}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ) ON CONFLICT (generation_job_id) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO chapter_analysis_execution_attempts ( attempt_id, generation_job_id, attempt_number, claim_request_id, device_id, credential_ref, credential_generation, input_fingerprint, checkpoint, lease_token_hash, lease_expires_at, fencing_token, last_observation_sequence, submission_intent_id, conversation_id, output_hash, completion_payload_hash, terminal_reason, slot_held, row_version, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( COALESCE(#{attemptId}, uuidv7()), #{generationJobId}, #{attemptNumber}, #{claimRequestId}, #{deviceId}, #{credentialRef}, #{credentialGeneration}, #{inputFingerprint}, #{checkpoint}, #{leaseTokenHash}, #{leaseExpiresAt}, #{fencingToken}, #{lastObservationSequence}, #{submissionIntentId}, #{conversationId}, #{outputHash}, #{completionPayloadHash}, #{terminalReason}, #{slotHeld}, 0, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ) ON CONFLICT (device_id, claim_request_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM chapter_analysis_execution_attempts WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND claim_request_id = #{claimRequestId}
SELECT * FROM chapter_analysis_execution_attempts WHERE generation_job_id = #{generationJobId} AND slot_held
mapper.update: UPDATE chapter_analysis_execution_attempts SET checkpoint = #{row.checkpoint}, lease_token_hash = #{row.leaseTokenHash}, lease_expires_at = #{row.leaseExpiresAt}, fencing_token = #{row.fencingToken}, last_observation_sequence = #{row.lastObservationSequence}, submission_intent_id = #{row.submissionIntentId}, conversation_id = #{row.conversationId}, output_hash = #{row.outputHash}, completion_payload_hash = #{row.completionPayloadHash}, terminal_reason = #{row.terminalReason}, slot_held = #{row.slotHeld}, row_version = row_version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE attempt_id = #{row.attemptId} AND row_version = #{expectedRowVersion} AND fencing_token = #{expectedFencingToken} AND #{row.fencingToken} >= #{expectedFencingToken}
